content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to connect a [product_name] to my PC but I keep receiving the error 'unable to access the remote device.' I previously connected this device to a laptop without issues, but now need to use my PC. The main difference is that my PC is on the company network while the laptop wasn't. Is it possible that this is related to firewall restrictions? I'm currently using [product_name] [version_no]. Best regards [user_name]

Hi [user_name], If you haven't already, try installing [product_name] [version_no]. You can find the download for the [product_name] Software Upgrade online. Also, here's a forum thread that may help: [document]
Hi [user_name], Apologies, I should have mentioned that I'm already using [version_no]. Best regards [user_name]
Hi [user_name], Are the PC and laptop running the same operating system?
Yes, both use the same OS. I just discovered that a printer on the network was using the same IP address as the [product_name], so I've changed the device's IP address and will see if that helps.
Yes, update the IP address of your [product_name]. You should then try pinging it from the PC to confirm the PC can detect the device.
It appears that the company network might restrict connections from the PC to the [product_name]. You may want to discuss with your IT team.
Hello both, I've reached out to our IT department to address this, as I can't see any other reason for the connection issue.
The screenshot indicates your PC has a virtual network subnet installed.
The latest [product_name] version is [version_no]. You can download the upgrade and installation instructions here: [document]

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge is difficulty connecting a [product_name] device to a PC, resulting in the error 'unable to access the remote device.' Participants discuss possible causes, including firewall settings, overlapping IP addresses on the network, and company network security restrictions. Upgrading software to the latest version is suggested, and ultimately the company's IT department is involved for resolution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to connect the [product_name] device to their PC with the same ease as they previously did with a laptop, and hopes to avoid network or setup complications.
